title: SWEET POTATOES
instructions: Take six sweet potatoes, not too large, scrape them on a scraper. Add two spoonfuls of water,  salt,  pepper,  sugar to taste, and a spoonful of butter. Mix all together to the consistency of a good paste. Put in a dish that goes to the fire, and place in the oven. Before doing so, take a straw and stick it on top to allow evaporation.
